ODA v5.4.1 section 10.1 shows R13-R15 CLASS records have no instance-count field (section 10.2 introduces it for R2004+); neither that default nor the decoder report proves zero instances. The diagnostic build reaches a GEODATA CLASS profile refusal after the unsafe layout bypass.
